text:
maya (Finance Ops): FYI — got an invoice from AegisLab (inv# AG-4521) for $42,360 that hit AP but there's no PO on it. Can someone help route?

connor (AP): Can you attach the PDF? AP system needs either PO or GL code to route.

maya (Finance Ops): attaching PDF (link: https://files.redwood/aegis/ag-4521.pdf). Key lines:
```
Invoice: AG-4521
Vendor: AegisLab
Amount: $42,360.00
Description: Dedicated GPU reserved capacity Mar 1–31
PO: <blank>
```

ethan (Procurement): @maya thx. AegisLab was onboarded under vendor name "Aegis Labs, Inc." We have POs 9001-RED-2026 and 9002-RED-2026 but neither equals this amount. Do we have a signed change order?

maya (Finance Ops): Vendor claims this is a usage true-up for the Dedicated contract (contract# RDW-DED-2026). They emailed a signed change-order that references change-order #CO-17. No PO # in the email.

connor (AP): If there's a change order then we need a matching PO or a procurement exception. @ethan can you confirm the CO and create/attach PO to AP?

ethan (Procurement): digging. Looks like CO-17 exists but procurement didn't issue a PO for true-ups — we created a billing alias for running usage and assumed invoice-level reconciliation. Not ideal. I can create a retro PO (PO-RET-3345) but need approver.

sarah (Finance Ops): @anna can you approve retro PO-RET-3345 for AegisLab usage true-up? This blocks vendor payment and they're pinging us.

anna (Head of Platform): I need a short breakdown: what the invoice covers and whether usage fits the committed capacity. If it exceeds committed, we need documented overage approval. @ethan share the usage report.

ethan (Procurement): Uploaded usage report: https://internal.redwood/reports/aegis/usage-mar2026.csv. Summary: charged for 7,200 GPU-hours; committed pool was 6,000 GPU-hours. Overage = 1,200 GPU-hours -> $42,360 appears to match that delta. I'll also draft the retro PO and the rationale.

maya (Finance Ops): Vendor is pushing for net-30. AP is holding until PO/approval attached. Vendor contact is katie@aegislabs.com — she offered a credit note if we can finalize this week.

connor (AP): Queueing payment on hold. Marked as "Pending PO" in the system. 

anna (Head of Platform): Approved pending procurement note: confirm overage calc and attach usage CSV to the PO. Approve PO-RET-3345 for payment once docs attached. :white_check_mark:

ethan (Procurement): Will create PO-RET-3345 and attach CO-17 + usage CSV + invoice PDF. ETA 1 business day. @maya can you confirm vendor bank details before payment?

maya (Finance Ops): Confirmed bank details with vendor on call. I'll drop final confirmation here after PO is created.

ap-bot: Invoice AG-4521 status changed to "On hold (Pending PO)" by connor at 1816789580.

connor (AP): Once PO is attached and @anna's approval is recorded, I will release for payment. Thanks everyone.
